title: Warhawk combat effectiveness

build.scope: Predicted radar history excluded from physical avoidance; all authored combat coefficients unchanged.
build.freshness: Private target; Simulation lib.rs timestamp refreshed before sequential owner tests and build.

reconstruction.source: B4 binary cd67f03a; authored63356d71; NDJSON trace from actual headless host
reconstruction.method: Reconstruct hazard formula from published own Helm state and contact positions. JS trigonometry/one publication interval can differ from exact deterministic tick; values are diagnostic approximations, not new simulation outputs.

validation.summary: 148 distinct focused native tests passed (135 Gameplay, 11 measured-Helm, 2 shipped-hull loading). The no-default-features Simulation build passed. All 40 balance runs executed: 39 victories and one draw. Seed 3 deterministic replay matched all 38 checkpoints and the final digest. PASM validate/scan/traceability, owned-file rustfmt, diff checks and affected-wiki lint passed. Independent source review found no actionable issue. Full pre-push gates and human/device acceptance were not run.

tests.command: cargo test -p phoenix-simulation --lib --no-default-features -- surfaces_measured predicted_and_missing_helm_scope actual_helm_frame public_chart_geometry strict_mode_accepts_every_shipped_hull strict_mode_is_on_by_default
tests.note: Three measured tests repeat in the complete group; two are shipped-hull checks.

replay.limitation: Same frozen local content. Existing generated opponent template warning remains; this is not portable-save content-closure evidence.

build.warning: Existing unused native audio methods take_authored/take_computer; no full clippy gate claimed.

balance.remaining: Four death-TTK checks lack death samples in each matrix. Fresh Destroyer seed 7 is an inactive draw at 120 seconds, so its win-rate check also fails.

review.caveat: All predicted contacts lose automatic obstacle eligibility; retained current/charted contacts and physical collision handling do not guarantee collision safety.

runtime: Project predicted radar records as non-dangerous while retaining history/uncertainty
Make steering avoidance honour the existing dangerous flag, as shared hazard assessment already does

limits: All predicted contacts are excluded from automatic collision avoidance, including a temporarily lost lone contact. This is an eligibility policy, not proof that physical collisions cannot occur.
Current contacts and charted geometry retain avoidance; fresh duplicate contacts are not fused by this change.
Headless AI duels do not establish human/device acceptance or wall-time performance.
Neutralization victory and death-TTK remain separate metrics.
